nodes.name: theorem:main
nodes.statement:
Let~$N$ be any positive integer, and let
$f(\tau) \in \mathbf{Z}  \llbracket q^{1/N} \rrbracket$ for~$q = \exp(\pi i \tau)$ be a holomorphic
function on the upper half plane~$\mathbf{H}$. Suppose there exists an integer~$k$ and a finite index
 subgroup~$\Gamma \subset \mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbf{Z})$ such that
$$f \left( \frac{a \tau + b}{c \tau + d}\right) = (c \tau + d)^k f(\tau), \quad \quad
\textrm{for all } \left( \begin{matrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{matrix} \right) \in \Gamma,$$
and suppose that~$f(\tau)$ is meromorphic at the cusps,
that is, locally extends to a meromorphic function near every cusp in the compactification
of~$\mathbf{H}/\Gamma$.
Then~$f(\tau)$ is a modular form for a congruence subgroup of~$\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbf{Z})$.

nodes.name: growth term
nodes.statement:
For each of the choices
$$
p(x) \in \big\{ x^N,  x^N / (x^N - 1), \, 1/(x^N-1) \big\}, 
$$
we have uniformly in $N \in \mathbf{N}_{> 0}$ and $r \in (0,1)$ the mean growth bound
\addtocounter{subsubsection}{1}\begin{equation} 
\int_{|z| = r} \log^+|p \circ F_N| \, \mu_{\mathrm{Haar}} \ll \log{\frac{N}{1-r}}, 
\end{equation}
with some (effectively computable) absolute  implicit constant.

nodes.name: exactconformal
holonomy
nodes.statement:
Let $0 \in U \subset \mathbf{C}$ be an open subset containing the origin. If the uniformization radius of the pointed
Riemann surface $(U,0)$ is strictly greater than $1$, then the algebra $\mathcal{V}(U,\mathbf{Z})$ is finite-dimensional as a $\mathbf{Q}(x)$-vector space. 

More precisely, let $p(x) \in \mathbf{Q}(x) \smallsetminus \mathbf{Q}$ be a non-constant  rational function without poles in $U$, 
and let
$\varphi(z) : \overline{D(0,1)} \to U$ be  a holomorphic map taking $\varphi(0) = 0$ with $|\varphi'(0)| > 1$. 
 If
\addtocounter{subsubsection}{1}\begin{equation} 
x(t) \in t +  t^2 \mathbf{Q}\llbracket t \rrbracket
\end{equation}
has $p(x(t)) \in \mathbf{Z}\llbracket t \rrbracket$, 
then
 the following dimension bound holds on $\mathcal{V}(U,x(t),\mathbf{Z})$ over
$\mathbf{Q}(p(x))$:
  \addtocounter{subsubsection}{1}\begin{equation} 
\dim_{\mathbf{Q}(p(x))} \mathcal{V}(U,x(t),\mathbf{Z})   \leq e  \cdot \frac{  \int_{\mathbf{T}} \log^+{|p \circ \varphi|} \, \mu_{\mathrm{Haar}}}{\log{|\varphi'(0)|}}.
  \end{equation}

nodes.name: abstract form
selfcontained
nodes.statement:
Suppose that there exists a constant~$C$ and a bound
$$[R_{2N}:M_2] \le C N^3 \log N$$
for all  integers~$N$. Then~$R_{2N} = M_{2N}$ for every~$N$, that is,
the unbounded denominators conjecture holds.

nodes.name: fix
nodes.statement:
Suppose that~$(p,2N)=1$ is  prime.
Suppose that~$f(\tau) \in R_{2N}$ is \emph{not} invariant under a congruence subgroup.
Then the form~$f(p \tau)$ is not in the~$M_{2Np}$-algebra generated by~$R_{2N}$.

trivialsupFN
nodes.statement:
For $N \gg 1$ and $r\in (0,1)$, we have
\[\sup_{|z|=r} \log |F_N(z)|\ll \frac{N}{1-r},\]
where the implicit constants are both absolute.

nodes.name: strategy
nodes.statement:
Let~$F_N: D(0,1) \rightarrow \mathbf{C} \smallsetminus  \mu_N$ be an analytic universal covering map sending~$0$  to~$0$.
Suppose that:
\begin{enumerate}
\item  The conformal radius $|F_N'(0)|$ of~$F_N$ is asymptotically at least
$$16^{1/N} \left(1 + \frac{A}{N^3} \right)$$
 for some constant~$A > 0$.
\item   For a fixed $B > 0$, the following mean value bound holds on the circle $|z| = 1 - BN^{-3}$: 
$$
\int_{|z| = 1 - BN^{-3}} \log^+{|F_N|} \, \mu_{\mathrm{Haar}}   \ll_B \frac{\log{N}}{N}.
$$
\end{enumerate}
Then the $\mathbf{Q}(\lambda)$-vector space $R_{2N}$ generated by the modular functions with Fourier coefficients in $\mathbf{Q}$ and bounded denominators at the cusp $\zeta = i \infty$, and having cusp widths dividing~$2N$ at all cusps $\zeta \in \mathbf{P}^1(\mathbf{Q})$, has dimension at most~$CN^3\log{N}$ over the field $\mathbf{Q}(\lambda)$ of modular functions of
level~$\Gamma(2)$,
for some absolute constant~$C$.
